botPerformance.scope: All active bot frames, including zero-plan frames and the terminal transition. Advance includes ordinary shared simulation. Diagnostics includes construction, JSON and synchronous publication ONLY; async HTML callbacks are measured separately in the persistent terminal export. Paused/countdown/suppressed cohorts are separate; post-bot-terminal continuation is excluded. P95 is a .05ms histogram upper bound, saturated-bin bound uses exact maximum. Previous completed diagnostic cost is reported by frame; persistent terminal export cost appears in subsequent scalar reports until the next attempt and is outside the frozen active cohort.
